Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery. Due to health and safety reasons we cannot accept the return of this product unless all petrol and oil have been drained (your statutory rights are not affected).

Powered by a STIGA ST140 OHV Autochoke 139cc engine. Easy-to-use mower with a 46cm cutting width, 6 cutting heights and a mulching plug. Clippings are collected into a large 60Ltr grass bag. An integrated front bumper handle and camlock adjusters make moving or folding the handles for storage as quick and easy as possible. Suitable for lawns up to 1500m². This product requires 4-stroke oil (not included).
b: 2 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
